solution.title: Solution
solution.locked: Press Check once first. The solution unlocks after your first attempt.
solution.note: Using the solution counts as help, so a pass will read "Solved with help".

reset.confirm: Reset this exercise? Your code and progress for it will be cleared.

stale.message: This exercise was updated since you last worked on it. Your code is kept.

results.title: Checks
results.idle: Press Check to run your code against the checks.
results.contractTitle: The checks can't run until your code matches the Contract.
results.compileTitle: Your code doesn't compile yet. Fix these first, then check again.
results.error: The checks couldn't run this time. Your code is safe. Check again, or reload the page if this keeps happening.
results.outdated: These results are for an earlier version of your code. Check again.

largerScreen: This exercise works best on a larger screen.

storage.unavailable: Progress can't be saved in this browser, so this exercise's progress resets when you leave the page. Hints, the solution and checks still work.
storage.saveFailed: Your latest progress couldn't be saved, so it resets when you leave the page. Hints, the solution and checks still work.

solvedWithHelp: Solved with help — every check passed.

unavailable.unknownTitle: There is no exercise at this address
unavailable.unknownBody: The Catalog lists every pattern and its exercises.
